        login_page = LoginPage(page)

            'existing_exchange': 'Credentials with given api key already exists',
            'invalid_values': 'Invalid Apikey or Signature'
        }
    
        with allure.step("Test preparation"):
            login_page.goto()
            create_session()
    
        with allure.step("Go to credentials page"):
            credentials_page.goto(endpoint=credentials_page.slug)
    
        with allure.step("Open connect exchange modal"):
            credentials_page.click_connect_exchange_btn()
            assert credentials_page.wait_for_connect_exchange_modal() is True
    
        with allure.step("Enter exchange data"):
            if connect_type != "empty_fields":
                credentials_page.select_exchange("Poloniex")
                credentials_page.insert_api_key(api_key)
                credentials_page.insert_secret_key(secret_key)
            credentials_page.click_save_btn()
    
        with allure.step("Verify validation messages"):
            if connect_type == "empty_fields":
                assert credentials_page.get_api_key_input_validation_msg() == api_key_validation_message
                assert credentials_page.get_secret_key_input_validation_msg() == secret_key_validation_message
                assert credentials_page.is_save_button_disabled() is True

                assert alert.wait_for_danger_alert() is True
